title: KVBoost: Chunk-Level Key-Value Cache Reuse with Deviation-Guided Recomputation for Efficient Large Language Model Inference
abstract: arXiv:2608.21362v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) incur high prefill latency because key-value (KV) tensors must be recomputed for each request. Existing prefix-caching systems reduce this cost but require prompts to share a leading contiguous prefix, limiting effectiveness when shared content appears at arbitrary positions. We present KVBoost, a chunk-level KV cache reuse system for HuggingFace-compatible decoder models that enables reuse regardless of content position. KVBoost introduces a dual-hash keying scheme that separates positional identity (prefix hash) from content identity (content hash), supporting both exact and approximate cache matches. To address attention boundary errors from independently cached chunks, KVBoost employs two repair strategies: SelectiveRecompute, which re-encodes boundary regions, and CacheBlendRecompute, which identifies and recomputes high-deviation tokens after a probe pass. translated_title: KVBoost：基于偏差引导重计算的块级键值缓存复用，用于高效的大语言模型推理
translated_abstract: 基于Transformer的大语言模型（LLMs）因每个请求必须重新计算键值（KV）张量而面临较高的预填充延迟。现有的前缀缓存系统降低了这一成本，但要求提示词共享一个连续的前缀，这限制了共享内容出现在任意位置时的有效性。我们提出了KVBoost，一个面向HuggingFace兼容解码器模型的块级KV缓存复用系统，无论内容位置如何都能实现复用。KVBoost引入了一种双哈希键控方案，将位置身份（前缀哈希）与内容身份（内容哈希）分离，支持精确和近似缓存匹配。为解决独立缓存块引起的注意力边界误差，KVBoost采用两种修复策略：选择性重计算（SelectiveRecompute），重新编码边界区域；以及缓存融合重计算（CacheBlendRecompute），在探测通过后识别并重新计算高偏差令牌。该系统还整合了...
tldr: KVBoost通过双哈希键控和偏差引导重计算，实现了任意位置内容的块级KV缓存复用，显著降低了LLM推理中的预填充延迟。
en_tdlr: KVBoost enables chunk-level KV cache reuse at arbitrary content positions via dual-hash keying and deviation-guided recomputation, significantly reducing prefill latency in LLM inference.
